name: new_unchecked
declaration: const unsafe fn new_unchecked (buffer : [MaybeUninit < T > ; N] , initialized : Range < usize > ,) -> Self
rules: All elements in `buffer[initialized]` must be initialized.
The range `initialized` must be canonical: `initialized.start <= initialized.end`.
The range `initialized` must be in bounds for `buffer`: `initialized.end <= N`, even if the range is empty.
Elements of `buffer` outside `initialized` may also be initialized without violating safety.
